title: Big Win for Iran: U.S. Backs Down on Conditions, Agrees to Iranian Venue For Nuclear Talks | DETAILS
text: Big Win for Iran: U.S. Backs Down on Conditions, Agrees to Iranian Venue For Nuclear Talks | DETAILSDiplomacy returned from the brink as regional leaders urgently warned Washington against abandoning talks with Tehran. The sudden reversal follows days of confusion, threats, and rising fears that the collapse of negotiations could trigger military escalation. Iran pushed for a bilateral meeting focused solely on nuclear issues, sidelining missile and regional security concerns. U.S. officials agreed reluctantly, citing respect for allies while remaining deeply sceptical of Iran’s intentions.
